subject: Cortexa pilot onboarding — PO requirement negotiation
messages:
From: Ari Gomez <ari.gomez@cortexa.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procure+pilot@cortexa.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cortexa pilot: onboarding & billing — PO requirement?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with a four-week pilot (up to 300k tokens/day). Legal asked us to confirm your procurement requirements before we kick off: does Redwood require a formal PO for pilot invoices, or is there an invoice-only path for short pilots?

We prefer keeping procurement lightweight for pilots to move faster. If a PO is mandatory, could you outline timing and any minimum commitment thresholds? Attached is a draft SOW and our W9 to speed vendor setup.

Attachments: Cortexa_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW, 2 pages), Cortexa_W9.pdf (W9)

Next steps we need from our side:
- Confirmation of whether a temporary invoice-only lane is possible for pilots under $10k total
- If PO required, contact for PO issuance and expected lead time

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Ari Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Cortexa
ari.gomez@cortexa.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Gomez <ari.gomez@cortexa.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cortexa pilot: onboarding & billing — PO requirement?

Thanks Ari — looping in Procurement (Priya) and Contracts (Karthik) to confirm process. Quick context for internal: Cortexa wants a 4-week pilot, low-risk, invoices likely under $8k for the trial period. They sent SOW and W9 (attached).

Priya / Karthik — can we do a temporary invoice-only onboarding for this pilot and make it conditional on: (1) signed SOW, (2) W9, (3) SOC2 attestation / insurance cert? If Procurement needs formal approval, suggest a one-off exception ticket and route invoices to ap+pilots@redwood.com.

If we can't waive PO for the pilot, how long to get a PO in the system (lead time) and is there a minimum threshold? Cortexa has asked for an accelerated path.

Action items:
- Priya: confirm exception process and required evidence
- Karthik: confirm whether Contracts wants a signed SOW or an MSA addendum for the pilot

Ari — thanks for sending the SOW/W9. I’ll coordinate internally and follow up by EOD tomorrow.

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Gomez <ari.gomez@cortexa.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cortexa pilot: onboarding & billing — PO requirement?

Marcus / Karthik — thanks for the ping. Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only path for pilots under $10k, but we require a short checklist completed and evidence uploaded to the vendor record. Minimum acceptable items:

- Completed vendor intake form (I attached our checklist template)
- W9 or equivalent tax docs (received)
- Proof of insurance (COI) naming Redwood as additional insured OR waiver from Risk
- Security attestation (SOC 2 Type II report or self-attestation questionnaire)
- Bank remittance details for Cortexa

If Cortexa can provide the above within 48 business hours, Procurement will create an exception ticket and authorize invoice-only billing for the 4-week pilot. We will add an expiry on the exception (30 days after pilot end) and require review before any renewal/production ramp.

Routing instructions: send invoices to ap+pilots@redwood.com and include "CORTEXA-PILOT" in the invoice reference. We'll work with AP to ensure these invoices are processed without a PO.

I also created a provisional ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/PROC-1427 (Procurement exception request). Please attach the evidence to the ticket.

Attachments: procurement_checklist_v2.xlsx (vendor intake + exception checklist)

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
